title: Delayed identification, same driver
description: The trip runs and closes live (delay mode none, IGN_OFF at 150). The scenario sets up the asset's standing assignee as driver A beforehand. One HARDBRAKE at atSec 30, before the identification's claimed atSec 80, so it is a violation raised while the driver was still unknown -- this is the violation the `noTransfers: true` assertion depends on. The identification claims atSec 80 (inside the trip) but is not delivered until atSec 250, one hundred seconds after the trip already closed. Must prove: the trip's own assignee is still genuinely set, from null to A, by this identification, and it is flagged arrived_after_trip_ended. Must NOT change: because the asset assignee is already A, resulted_in_assignee_change must be false and no threshold event may be transferred.

events.note: violation while the driver is still unknown; noTransfers depends on this

driver_identifications.note: delayed identification, timestamp inside the already-closed trip; same driver as the asset's pre-existing standing assignee
